assay: bulk RNA-seq of whole hippocampus (SMART-seq v4 + Nextera XT, NovaSeq; STAR GeneCounts) (S6.9.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of runner plasma (RP; pooled plasma from male C57BL/6 mice with 28 d voluntary wheel running) versus control plasma (CP; sedentary standard-cage donors) infused retro-orbitally every 3 d for 28 d into young non-running recipients, on the recipient hippocampal transcriptome (S1.p3, S6.3.p1, Fig. 1a,h)
inclusion: n = 8 recipient mice per group (FIG12 Fig. 1h legend); male donors and sex/age matched recipients
planned_contrasts: RP vs CP, hippocampus, no LPS (S1.p3, Fig. 1h; paper: 1,952 DEGs, 61% down / 39% up)
LPS+RP vs LPS+CP, hippocampus (S2.p1, Fig. 2b; separate experiment, case GSE164401_HC_LPS)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one hippocampus per recipient mouse
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.32 default (built-in) Wald test, ~ treatment (S6.9.p1)
